cases.behavior: Keep the image npm content cache outside Native project input discovery while preserving all other root-home business inputs.
cases.reproduction: The round-5 zero-model container archived successfully after its 240-second host wait expired; native next --accept-result spent minutes traversing .dataset-state/root/.npm/_cacache, observed in its live file descriptors. The final check snapshot had only 16 files.
cases.expected: Relocate only npm _cacache with byte-preserving execution and scoring mounts. Keep other /root business generated inputs bound and keep /root benchmark workdirs unchanged; legacy layouts remain readable.
cases.forbidden: Deleting cache bytes, excluding an entire root-home mirror, changing Native exclusions, hiding business generated inputs or grading different candidates.
cases.rootCause: The image root-home mirror was inside the project under an ordinary ignored directory, forcing generated-input discovery to traverse its package cache.

tests.namePattern: ^keeps Eval CLI tooling outside Native inputs while binding application generated files$
requiredNames: keeps Eval CLI tooling outside Native inputs while binding application generated files

evidence: Round-five final-layout preflight at .comet/eval/launches/2026-11-05-bugfree-hard-confirmation-r5c/preflight-bugfree-20261105-050308.json verified unchanged assembly, readonly CLI, actual npm cache bind bytes, 16 check inputs and original scoring with matching mode proof. The zero-model fixture did not implement the benchmark.

The same frozen product completed both original-task workflows: comet-eval-9c5f74e3-4133-448a-99d2-82e0fa6cf1bd and comet-eval-71a200a2-0576-4aed-9b4a-28cac3da03a5. Each original reward was 10/14, mode proof matched, and no reference access or input/assembly mismatch was recorded. This verifies the harness boundary, not full task correctness.

cases.behavior: Install the frozen Eval CLI as tooling under Eval state so Native generated-input discovery excludes it while preserving business generated-file checks and readonly CLI bindings.
cases.reproduction: The round-4 hard-task check snapshot had 727 files, including 705 from _eval_current_comet; two actual checks took 290 ms while the enclosing command took over a minute. The public Native SDK baseline regression included CLI dist files before repair.
cases.expected: Keep the CLI source and release identity bound, preserve readonly mounts for workdir aliases, retain all business dist inputs and candidate storage, and leave the project's node_modules namespace available to the original task.
cases.forbidden: Adding Native ignore exceptions for application inputs, hiding business dist changes, losing build identity or readonly mounts, or reserving the original task's root node_modules as a controller path.
cases.rootCause: The harness placed its CLI dist tree in the candidate root where Native correctly discovered it as ignored generated application input.
